changelog: 1.1.0 (Jellyfin 12.2 to 12.4): a diagnostic overlay shows, during playback in the browser, the quality downloaded, the bitrate actually received, the buffer, the picture displayed, dropped frames and the latest quality changes (off by default; administrators or everyone). The ladder always goes down to the minimum bitrate in regular steps, the setting becoming a maximum gap between two qualities (each at least half the bitrate above by default). New optional server control: the server times the sending of every segment and can wait before letting the quality go back up after a drop (30 s by default); measured in the browser on a network going up and down, a quarter fewer quality changes without more stalls. Off by default until checked on TV apps. The catalogue only lists a version once it can be installed.
description: Real adaptive bitrate for Jellyfin's HLS streams: the player changes quality with the network, without a cut.
name: Adaptive Bitrate
overview: A real quality ladder in Jellyfin's HLS streams: quality follows the network, without a cut.
